title: Princess Leia
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Princess Leia has reason to fear for brother Luke (front, cover by Dave Dorman) as he begins to turn toward the dark side in DARK EMPIRE, the series from Dark Horse Comics. Dorman has specialized in illustrating the fantastic in a realistic —almost cinematic— style. He's a perfect match for story artist Cam Kennedy who depicts a space battle (back) that leaps off the page.
